Gold at 4,128.08. I want to separate "upward" from "still has room to rise."

As of 23:18 on November 9, based on XS's MT5 XAUUSDc, I organize the chart on the daily and 4-hour timeframes.

【Even above the averages, check what lies overhead】
On the 4-hour chart, SMA20 is 4,090.01 and SMA50 is 4,019.99. The 20 is above the 50, and price is above the 20. The direction leans upward.

However, the arrangement of the averages is material for reading the state of the market. It does not guarantee room for further upside in the short term. I see the range from today's/this week's high of 4,134.14 to last week's high of 4,146.89 as an overhead resistance zone. Above that is the round number 4,150.00.

【If it moves up, what to watch】
If price breaks above 4,134.14-4,146.89 and keeps moving even above 4,150.00, then 4,200.00 to the past-20-day high of 4,217.22 is interesting as the next zone to observe.

The reason is that beyond the cluster of nearby highs, the round number and the upper limit of the past 20 days lie ahead. If price only wicks up and returns inside the zone, I record it separately from a breakout.

【If it moves down, what changes】
If price falls below the previous day's high of 4,106.89 to the round number 4,100.00, I recheck the short-term strength. If price cannot hold even around the 4-hour SMA20 of 4,090.01 below that, then from today's/this week's low of 4,054.34 to the previous day's low, which is also the 4-hour trough, 4,027.44, becomes the lower zone to observe.

However, I do not treat this whole wide zone as a single support. A move breaking 4,054.34 and a move collapsing all the way to the 4,027.44 trough have different effects on the structure.

【ATR is not the remaining distance】
The daily ATR(14) is about $85.2. I will not decide "it will only move this much more" by looking only at today's high and low. ATR is a guide to the range, not an upper limit or a quota.

In verifying the hide-style indicator and the range EA as well, I want to record direction, zone position, and moves pushed back by wicks as a set. Even when it is upward, there are times to wait if price is near the upper limit, and if the range widens, I also check the expected loss amount.

I publish verification notes in the open chat "Hide Gold FX Study Group" in my profile. Trade at your own discretion.

4,146.89-4,150.00. I want to see the gold "wall" as an overlap rather than a single line.

As of 06:59 on November 10, XS's MT5 XAUUSDc is at 4,141.02. Splitting the chart into daily and 4-hour, both an upward flow and the possibility of stalling in the nearby high zone can be seen at the same time.

【Highs are concentrated above】
Last week's high 4,146.89, today's/this week's high 4,148.50, and above that the round number 4,150.00. Because separate grounds are gathered close together, I observe this as a resistance zone with width.

The current price is above the recent 4-hour peak of 4,134.14. But that alone does not let me judge that it has passed through the high zone. I separate whether it leaves an upper wick and returns below the zone, or whether the body stays above the zone. I separate reaching a price from being accepted there.

【If it moves up】
If it breaks above 4,150.00 and keeps moving above that, the round number 4,200.00 up to the past-20-day high of 4,217.22 is interesting as the next zone to observe. However, this does not mean there is no resistance along the way.

【If it moves back down】
If it is pushed back at the high zone, I focus on the previous day's high of 4,106.89 to the round number 4,100.00. It is a zone to see whether the decline settles near the earlier highs.

If it falls below here too, the 4-hour SMA20 at 4,093.44 and then today's/this week's low of 4,054.34 come into view. If that breaks, I want to confirm the positional relationship with the previous day's low of 4,027.44, which is also the 4-hour trough.

【Discretionary trading and EA: organize the location first】
SMA20 is above SMA50 at 4,021.23, and the current price is above SMA20. Even if it leans upward, the reaction near the range upper limit is not necessarily the same. In verifying the hide-style indicator and the range EA too, I want to record the inside and outside of the high zone separately. Results change depending on whether a pass by wick alone is counted as a breakout. The daily ATR is about $86.2. Considering the size of price movement, waiting where the judgment is ambiguous is also money management.

I publish verification notes in the open chat "Hide Gold FX Study Group" in my profile. Trade at your own discretion.
